payload.answer: No infrastructure change: same Netlify site (hire-adam-steinberger, @netlify/plugin-nextjs v5 running the Next server), same [path] Node route streaming SSE. Routing is Next-native in next.config.ts: rewrites() { beforeFiles: [ { source: '/', has: [{ type: 'host', value: 'chat.adam.matthewsteinberger.com' }], destination: '[path]' } ] } plus three redirects placed first: chat-host [path] -> https://chat.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/ (308); chat-host '[path]((?!api/|_next/|.*\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$).+)' -> https://hire.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/:path (308, query preserved); hire-host [path] -> https://chat.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/ (308). These rules are already verified with next build + curl. No middleware.ts, no proxy.ts, no Netlify _redirects/netlify.toml rules. The subdomain itself is a Netlify domain alias plus one Porkbun DNS CNAME (chat.adam -> hire-adam-steinberger.netlify.app) — manual steps documented in AGENTS.md, not automated.
